meta.defaultDescription: Physical NFC products and digital scenarios for businesses in Moldova and Romania. AI consultant, configurator, and Telegram handoff.

home.headline: one nfc object. one tap. one conversion.
home.subhead: We match the stand, material, and digital scenario — reviews, smart menu, or interactive page — then hand everything to a manager in Telegram.
home.why1Body: We pair the physical product with the customer action you want: review, menu, check-in, lead.
home.why2Body: Short questions, a few concrete ideas, a structured offer — no endless form.
home.why3Body: Configuration, concept, and image reach the manager with context intact.
home.catalogNote: Standard stand: 1–2 @ 450 MDL; 3–6 @ 400; 7–10 @ 350; 11–19 @ 300; 20+ @ 250. Custom = individually quoted.
home.leadTitle: send the idea to a manager
home.leadSub: We reply in Telegram. No cart, no fake checkout.

faq.q1: Do you deliver in Moldova and Romania?
faq.a1: Yes — primary markets are Moldova and Romania. Delivery details are confirmed on Telegram.
faq.q2: Can I order NFC stickers only?
faq.a2: Yes, but we help attach them to a useful digital scenario — not an empty URL.
faq.a3: No. The consultant uses the catalog and marks unknowns as “confirm with manager”.
faq.a4: To control cost and move quickly into a manager conversation once the idea is clear.
